items.title: Anthropic becomes most valuable AI firm as shares soar in stock market debut
items.summary: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.
items.titleZh: 随着股票在股市首次亮相时飙升，Anthropic成为最有价值的人工智能公司
items.summaryZh: Anthropic是第一家上市的纯人工智能公司，为整个行业创造了一个测试。

items.title: Social Security has less than 6 years before a 22% cut. A Senate chairman’s fix is to borrow $190 trillion and call it the ‘Stop Scaring Seniors Act’
items.summary: A nonpartisan watchdog called Ron Johnson’s proposal a “cynical pander that ducks all the real decisions.”
items.titleZh: 社会保障在不到6年的时间里就削减了22%。参议院主席的解决方案是借款190万亿美元，并称之为“停止恐吓老年人法案”
items.summaryZh: 一家无党派监督机构称罗恩·约翰逊的提议是“玩世不恭的迎合，回避了所有真正的决定”

items.title: Sound Ventures turned $435 million into a $7 billion Anthropic stake. Ashton Kutcher left months before the IPO
items.summary: Sound Ventures, co-founded by Guy Oseary and Ashton Kutcher, put about $435 million into Anthropic.
items.titleZh: Sound Ventures将4.35亿美元转化为70亿美元的Anthropic股份。Ashton Kutcher在IPO前几个月离职
items.summaryZh: 由Guy Oseary和Ashton Kutcher共同创立的Sound Ventures向Anthropic投入了约4.35亿美元。

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
items.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia following an affair, which could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.summaryZh: 黄仁勋因一件事从英伟达辞职，这件事可能会对国家安全产生影响，因为美国和中国正在竞相开发最先进的人工智能基础设施。

items.title: California bans Waymo robotaxis from its freeways over construction zones
items.summary: ‘An imminent hazard to public safety’: California’s DMV bans Waymo from freeways, and Waymo pauses freeway rides in every market.
items.titleZh: 加利福尼亚州禁止Waymo自动驾驶出租车在施工区的高速公路上行驶
items.summaryZh: “对公共安全的迫在眉睫的危险”：加利福尼亚州的DMV禁止Waymo在高速公路上行驶，Waymo在每个市场都暂停了高速公路的行驶。

items.title: Armand Hammer has what it takes to outlast the end times
items.summary: Their new album makes the case for rappers Elucid and billy woods as an era-defining team: attuned to a dark sociopolitical moment, yet powered by a humans-first creative ethic.
items.titleZh: 阿曼德·哈默拥有超越末日的力量
items.summaryZh: 他们的新专辑证明了说唱歌手Elucid和billy woods是一个划时代的团队：适应了黑暗的社会政治时刻，但以人类优先的创作伦理为动力。
